newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi cuts May Arab Super Light formula by 25 cts.
newsitem.headline: Saudi cuts May Arab Super Light formula by 25 cts.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has cut its May-lifting crude oil price formula for Arab Super Light to Asian customers by 25 cents a barrel, traders here said on Thursday.
The May term contract price for Arab Super Light was set at the Oman/Dubai average plus $2.70 cents, compared with plus $2.95 cents for April, traders said.
The price formulas for other Saudi Arabian crudes were also reduced by 10 to 20 cents for May purchases.
Saudi Aramco told Asian buyers that Arab Light for May would be priced at Oman/Dubai average plus 50 cents, down 10 cents from April.
Arab Medium and Arab Heavy were also reduced by 10 cents to Oman/Dubai less 50 cents and Oman/Dubai less $1.35, respectively.
Berri Extra Light was cut by 20 cents to Oman/Dubai plus $1.50.
